name: snipd
description: Access and search millions of podcast transcripts, summaries, and rich metadata. Ask questions, research guests, turn text into audio, and fully control the Snipd podcast app.

interface.longDescription:
This plugin lets you:
1. Get transcripts, summaries, and rich metadata such as chapters, guest bios, and popularity scores of millions of podcasts
2. Search through millions of podcast transcripts or search for episodes, shows, and guests
3. Control the Snipd podcast app such as queueing episodes, following shows, exporting snips, uploading audio or turning text into audio

Use Cases - without the app
- Get the main insights of a podcast
- Ask questions and get answers based on an episode, show or guest
- Look up something you heard on a podcast
- Monitor new episodes for specific topics and guests
- Recommend podcasts based on your interests
- Enrich your personal knowledge wikis (pkm) with podcast data
- Research what competitors have revealed on a podcast
- Discover interesting guests
- And much more...

Use Cases - with the app
- Export and organise your snips (=highlights) with transcript, summary, and metadata
- Triage new episodes and add the best ones to your queue
- Upload audio files
- Turn a web article into audio and listen on the app
- Create custom podcasts on a topic you want to learn more about
- Create custom notes on a podcast
- Analyse your listening behaviour over time
- Find all insights you've ever heard on a certain topic
- And much more...

What is Snipd?
Snipd is the #1 podcast app for knowledge seekers.
Available on iOS and Android and loved across the world by people who listen to learn.
This plugin also works without the Snipd podcast app.
capabilities: Get transcripts, summaries, chapters, guest bios and popularity scores of millions of podcasts
